news.title: Seattle’s Socialist Mayor Taunts the Rich as Rift with Starbucks Widens
news.summary: Seattle voters elected Mayor Katie Wilson as tensions rose over wealth inequality, but as Starbucks, one of the city’s most iconic companies, expands in Nashville, she is finding her limits.
